reason: I make about a thousand dollars a month, so $19 is real money to me, and with all my clients the documents would pass 100 fast and push me to $45. My clients will not pay extra, and I bill by the hour, so saving time just means earning less unless I find new clients.
objection: Who pays? I cannot put it on the client's bill, and I cannot eat $19 to $45 a month myself. Also only 5 groups per account, and I have more clients than that.
would_change_my_mind: A price that fits a solo bookkeeper, around $5 a month for all my clients, or a way to bill it to the client as a small service they agree to pay.
